facts.claim: Anatomy indexed from 'Digital Anatomy of Four Music-Marketing Machines' research report (2026-10-03); per-fact evidence tiers and sources recorded in attrs.key_facts

Why paid reach matters: Marquee/Showcase clicks produce saves, playlist adds, follows, and catalog streams - all inputs to Spotify's organic recommendation systems (Discover Weekly, Release Radar, Radio); paid reach seeds the signals the free algorithm feeds on

Discovery Mode flywheel: boosted Radio/Autoplay exposure -> new listeners -> on-demand/catalog streams at full royalty (only DM-context streams take the 30% cut) -> stronger algorithmic profile; industry analyses estimate 100-400% stream lifts during active campaigns

The Kit's own page positions Discovery Mode as the tool for 'trending' songs; social/press signals (TikTok virality, editorial coverage) amplify by raising baseline demand that Marquee retargeting and Discovery Mode then harvest
